infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Market Mapper uses your location to capture businesses, places and market paths.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Market Mapper uses your microphone for voice notes and team audio/video calls.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Market Mapper uses your camera for field photos and team video calls.
